d: Company Description Eizdam Group Contracting and Trading is a public company specializing in innovative construction and water solutions that support a sustainable future. The organization delivers contracting and trading services to diverse clients, with a strong focus on quality and reliability. Eizdam Group leverages modern technologies and industry best practices to provide efficient, future-ready infrastructure solutions. Applicants can learn more about the company’s services and projects through its corporate website at eizdam.com.

Role Description The Sales Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Doha, Qatar. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing client relationships, and promoting the company’s construction and water solutions. Day-to-day activities include conducting sales meetings and presentations, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating terms, and following up to close deals. The Sales Specialist will collaborate with technical and project teams to ensure accurate product and service information, provide ongoing customer support, and contribute to sales forecasts and reporting. The role also involves maintaining market awareness, participating in training sessions, and representing the company at industry events as needed.
q: Candidates should possess strong Sales skills, including lead generation, pipeline management, and deal closing.
Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills and Customer Service abilities to build and maintain client relationships.
Candidates should possess experience in Sales Management and Training to support sales processes and mentor team members.
Candidates should possess knowledge of construction or water solutions markets; experience in B2B sales is highly beneficial.
Candidates should possess good negotiation, presentation, and basic analytical skills, with proficiency in standard office and CRM software.
Candidates should possess a relevant diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; prior sales experience in Qatar or the GCC region is an advantage.
Do send the CV to bilal.merhi@eizdam.com or info@eizdam.com
